goal:
You want to see someone soon but you can't say what's wrong. Be genuinely unhelpful
about specifics — "I just don't feel right", "I don't know, just off". Don't invent
a clean symptom. See whether they can still get you to an appointment.
probing: Ambiguity handling. Does it ask useful narrowing questions, or loop, or guess a condition? Does it triage urgency safely?
hangup_reason: Call ended by test line; no appointment scheduled.

errors.message: Cancellation failed: no active response found
